name: Patient Pommeltuft
description: Seats qi along the full length of the edge before a cut so it stays there.

name: Eddyslap
description: Chops downward with the qi-laden edge to bite through the guard of a parrying blade.

name: Flexglide
description: Steps forward while loading qi into the edge so the cut lands at the end of the step.

name: Rooted Jianhilt
description: Parries with the qi-bearing edge so the opponent's blade is turned and nicked.

name: Swirlflog
description: Draws the qi-carrying edge across the opponent in a long slicing pass that bites through light armor.

name: Driftscorer
description: Releases stored edge qi through a thrust so the point pierces a guard that would stop it.

name: Sturdy Ridgecrest
description: Meets a cut with the flat held across the body and stays ready to counter.

name: Liltslap
description: Rises from the guard directly into a cut at the opponent's sword hand.

name: Padded Guardwing
description: Turns the wrist over to cover the hand and deflect a cut aimed at it.

name: Tasselzip
description: Takes a half step off the line of a cut and answers from the new angle.

name: Alert Knotcord
description: Uses the free sword fingers to check distance to the opposing blade before answering.

name: Willowscreen
description: Spreads qi across the flat to stop a heavy cut and then pushes the opposing blade away.

name: Guarding Tassel
description: Parries and thrusts back in one unbroken motion with the parry's qi carried into the thrust.

name: Gripping Twinspine
description: Crosses blades and holds contact at the middle of the flat to feel the opponent's push.

name: Cruel Springtip
description: Slips the point along the opposing blade out of a bind and into the opponent's body.

name: Tasselprop
description: Rolls the blade under the opposing sword and lifts it away from the centerline.

name: Swirlswat
description: Presses over the opposing blade and cuts down the forearm in the same motion.

name: Lilthurdle
description: Steps out of a bind to the side while keeping the point on the opponent.

name: Dense Waistbend
description: Holds the flat against the opposing blade so the bind cannot be broken from the other side.

name: Clutching Knotcord
description: Locks the two blades together with a pulse of qi so the opponent's sword cannot lift.

name: Entangling Swirl
description: Spirals the point out of a lock and breaks the opponent's grip with a sharp wrist turn.

name: Rippleslap
description: Cuts in a wide arc with qi held in the blade ready to be thrown.

name: Brawn Waistbend
description: Sets the feet and sword arm so that qi can be drawn up and thrown cleanly.

name: Ducking Drift
description: Recovers the stance after a wave cut with a short step back and the point raised.

name: Candor Knotcord
description: Sights along the blade to fix the line a thrown wave will travel.

name: Gleamripple
description: Throws a thin crescent of qi from the edge along the line of a long cut.

name: Static Swirl
description: Launches a rising crescent of qi from a low cut that climbs to chest height.

name: Bold Springtip
description: Opens the full course with a measured thrust from the ready stance.

name: Eddyswat
description: Cuts left then right across the opponent in a short cross pattern.

name: Stalwart Twinspine
description: Parries a cut aimed at the head with the blade raised and angled outward.

name: Resolute Jianhilt
description: Parries a cut aimed at the legs by dropping the point and turning the flat out.

name: Veering Flitter
description: Advances in measured paces while the blade keeps the opponent's line covered.

name: Slinking Eddy
description: Retreats in measured paces with the point following the opponent's chest.

name: Brass Flexspine
description: Links a thrust and a returning cut in one qi-fed motion that follows the opponent's parry.

name: Binding Pommeltuft
description: Slides along the opposing blade with qi in the flat to pin it against the opponent's body.

name: Harsh Eddy
description: Ends the course with a sweeping flourish that cuts across three heights in one turn.

name: Grim Springtip
description: Threads the point through a small gap in the guard like a needle through cloth.

name: Layered Flexspine
description: Rolls the wrist in a small spiral to carry an incoming blade off to the side.

name: Driftswat
description: Pulls the blade back through the opponent's arm after a thread-thin thrust.

name: Springing Knotcord
description: Steps in along a spiral path that curls around the opponent's lead guard.

name: Attentive Tassel
description: Touches the point lightly to the opposing blade to feel where it will move.

name: Shard Swirl
description: Corkscrews the point forward with spinning qi that widens the wound on entry.

name: Buttressed Waistbend
description: Weaves the blade in tight figures before the body so qi thickens into a screen.

name: Sure Waistbend
description: Draws the sword arm back and loads the legs like a spring before a thrust.

name: Raw Springtip
description: Releases the coiled arm into a straight thrust that gains reach from the legs.

name: Flexflog
description: Releases the coil upward under the opponent's guard in a short rising cut.

name: Rippleswerve
description: Steps aside from a charge while the arm stays coiled for the answering thrust.

name: Doughty Flitter
description: Releases two coiled thrusts in quick succession at the same spot on a guard.

name: Levering Jianhilt
description: Hooks the point under the opponent's guard and tears with qi to twist the weapon loose.

name: Gap Pommeltuft
description: Taps the point toward the opponent to measure the exact reach between the two blades.

name: Acrid Springtip
description: Pokes the point at the opponent from the very edge of reach and recovers at once.

name: Tasselslap
description: Cuts with the forte of the blade when the opponent has closed to short range.

name: Prowling Lilt
description: Breaks the rhythm of an exchange with an uneven step that hides the moment of attack.

name: Armored Guardwing
description: Holds the guard at the exact distance where an incoming cut falls short.

name: Liltscorer
description: Skips a beat in the expected rhythm and cuts into the pause.

name: Stubborn Knotcord
description: Waits for the opponent's first step and cuts with a surge of qi timed to it.

name: Rushing Flitter
description: Collapses the distance in one explosive lunge that reaches farther than the opponent expects.

name: Recall Flexspine
description: Watches the opponent's shoulder for the small lift that comes before a cut.

name: Sound Guardwing
description: Reads the shadow of the opposing blade on the floor to learn its angle early.

name: Unmoving Springtip
description: Raises the parry before the cut lands so the opposing blade meets steel at its start.

name: Driftflog
description: Answers a read tell with a cut aimed where the opponent's arm will be.

name: Scudding Tassel
description: Shows a false opening with the lead foot to bait a cut that can be read.

name: Lunar Twinspine
description: Feels the pulse of qi running along the opponent's blade to learn when it will cut.

name: Vicious Lilt
description: Sends the point to the spot where the read cut will begin and strikes before it starts.

name: Stalling Pommeltuft
description: Flicks the pommel tassel at the opponent's face to spoil the aim of a cut.

name: Flexswat
description: Cuts from behind the swing of the tassel so the blade's path is hidden.

name: Pirouetting Springtip
description: Steps in behind the swinging tassel to close the distance unseen.

name: Mirage Jianhilt
description: Passes the blade between hands under cover of the tassel's swing to confuse the reach.

name: Haze Waistbend
description: Spins the tassel with qi so it flares into a bright veil that hides the next cut.

name: Swift Knotcord
description: Throws the tassel to draw a parry then thrusts through the opening with qi.
